ينتحلون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَحِلُونَ (yantaḥilūna) /jan.ta.ħi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
# يُنْتَحَلُونَ (yuntaḥalūna) /jun.ta.ħa.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
